issue_context.title: Fix validation error type `GL03` and check in CI
issue_context.body:
#### Problem description

In order to have a continuous check by the CI on validation error `GL03` (Double line break found; please use only one blank line to separate sections or paragraphs, and do not leave blank lines at the end of docstrings), fixing them in the code base enables the addition to the CI for automated testing in the future.

`GL03` has 99 occurrences (see [overview of the errors](https://gist.github.com/198cfa552c727d71bd7360fda66fdbb4)), including:


| method | file | file_line | github_lin
|  --- | --- | --- | ---

review_comments: Does this still render the version added directive appropriately?

None of the current aggregate functions have version added directives, which is actually what's causing the errors here (three blank lines). In order to add them in the future we'll need to `dedent` the document before its substitution (similar to the `see_also` and `examples` directives), eg:

```
_agg_version_added_doc = dedent("""
Test version added doc
""")

@Substitution(see_also=_agg_see_also_doc,
              examples=_agg_examples_doc,
              versionadded=_agg_version_added_doc,
```

which renders the directive appropriately:

```
################################################################################
############# Docstring (pandas.core.resample.Resampler.aggregate) #############
################################################################################

Aggregate using one or more operations over the specified axis.

Test version added doc

Parameters
```
OK makes sense. I think in other places the version added actually gets passed in with a line break preceding the value so this would at least be consistent with other uses
